text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees focus on more important work. Instead of replacing people completely, AI often supports human-AI collaboration, where workers and machines solve problems together. Of course, this also brings job changes. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, such as AI trainers and data analysts. To succeed, employees need to learn new skills and adapt to a workplace where humans and AI work side by side.
